record.paper_title: Open problems in billiards and quantitative symplectic geometry
record.original_question: Do chaotic symplectic billiards exist in convex domains with C^1-smooth boundary?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Symplectic billiards are defined as follows. Let $D \subset \mathbb{R}^2$ be a bounded convex domain whose boundary $\partial D$ is a $C^1$ curve. For an ordered pair of points $(x, y) \in \partial D \times \partial D$ with $x \neq y$, the symplectic billiard map $T$ sends $(x, y)$ to $(y, z)$, where $z \in \partial D$ is the unique point such that the tangent line to $\partial D$ at $y$ is parallel to the chord $xz$ (equivalently, $z$ is characterized by maximizing/critical-value of the area functional $A(x,y,z) = \tfrac12\,\omega(z-x, y)$, where $\omega$ is the standard symplectic (area) form on $\mathbb{R}^2$). This map preserves the measure $\omega \wedge \omega$ on $\partial D \times \partial D$.

The symplectic billiard dynamical system $(T, \mu)$ is called chaotic if it has positive metric entropy with respect to its invariant measure (equivalently, a positive-measure set of orbits has a positive Lyapunov exponent).

Question: Does there exist a bounded convex domain $D \subset \mathbb{R}^2$ with $C^1$-smooth boundary such that the associated symplectic billiard map is chaotic?
artifact.status_search_result: The question appears in a recent compilation of open problems in billiards and quantitative symplectic geometry (2025/2026), where it is listed as open. Numerical evidence is mentioned suggesting the stadium as a candidate, but no proof of existence (or nonexistence) of chaotic symplectic billiards in convex $C^1$ domains has been published.

status_evidence.title: Open problems in billiards and quantitative symplectic geometry
status_evidence.snippet: Compilation of open problems including chaotic symplectic billiards in convex C^1 domains; stadium suggested as a candidate with numerical evidence.
status_evidence.claim: The existence of chaotic symplectic billiards in convex C^1 domains is listed as an open problem.
